fixed_whole_file_split.selection_rule: simple contiguous seed split fixed before transition-coverage inspection

mechanical_partition.control_rule: the unique numeric column changing at every noninitial train marker and never between markers
mechanical_partition.response_rule: numeric nonmetadata columns with non-marker within-segment variation in train

prospective_boundary.query: last 32 anonymous response vectors before intervention, current anonymous scalar control and requested horizon
prospective_boundary.prediction: complete horizon-by-10 response matrix emitted before any target reveal
prospective_boundary.reveal: frozen target response matrix revealed only after the complete prediction artifact is atomic
prospective_boundary.update: charged slot-local update after reveal; global refit is forbidden
prospective_boundary.depth_ood_label: evaluator-created rollout-depth extrapolation, not natural transition OOD

history_scales.episode_order: event index 1 through 9 outer, train seed 0 through 5 inner

mandatory_controls: pooled ridge or FIR impulse response
required_invalidation_fixtures: marker timestamp file seed or native-name leakage

activation_gate.required_cycle: separate no-scoring development-only baseline feasibility service
must_freeze: minimum meaningful effect above development noise
activation_gate.reject_if: persistence, control-level model bank or adaptive linear control solves the development task trivially or saturates declared quality

decision_reasons: anonymous control and response partition is mechanically identifiable from train files
three history scales and leakage-safe prequential ordering are feasible
the fixed split contains no unseen transition pair and test response lengths remain inside train range
horizon 96 can test depth extrapolation but must not be represented as natural OOD
baseline nontriviality is unknown and blocks benchmark activation
